newsitem.title: POLAND: Echo seeks transfer to main market.
newsitem.headline: Echo seeks transfer to main market.

text.p: Polish developer Echo Investment SA plans to transfer it shares to the Warsaw Stock Exchange's main market from the parallel floor, the daily Gazeta Wyborcza reported on Wednesday.

"By entering the main market we can find ourselves in the orbit of large Western funds which as a principle don't invest on the parallel market," Wyborcza quoted Echo board chairman Michal Solowow as saying.
He said the firm would submit a transfer application at the end of February or beginning of March next year.
In late September Echo shifted its core business to real estate from publishing.
It expects to net 2.7 million zlotys this year on sales of 50.5 million zlotys against a net of 0.4 million zlotys on sales of 7.3 million zlotys in 1995.
The parallel market lists less liquid, smaller stocks.
